muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿بل متعت هؤلاء وآباءهم حتى جاءهم الحق ورسول مبين﴾: «بل»: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction, the implied form being «وجعلها كلمة باقية في عقبه» (and he made it a word lasting among his descendants); «هؤلاء»: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «آباءهم»: conjoined to «هؤلاء», or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); «حتى»: a particle of limit and of the genitive; «جاءهم الحق»: a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil (agent); «رسول»: conjoined to «الحق»; «مبين»: a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿رسول﴾.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿ولما جاءهم الحق قالوا هذا سحر وإنا به كافرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لما»: connective, or temporal (ḥīniyya); «جاءهم الحق»: a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not make jussive; «هذا»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «سحر»: its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) of their saying; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «نا»: the noun of «إن»; «به»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كافرون﴾; «كافرون»: the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وقالوا لولا نزل هذا القرآن على رجل من القريتين عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قالوا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «لولا»: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) in the sense of «هلا» (why not); «نزل»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «هذا»: a demonstrative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «القرآن»: a badal (substitute); «على رجل»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزل﴾; «من القريتين»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿رجل﴾; «عظيم»: a second ṣifa of ﴿رجل﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿أهم يقسمون رحمت ربك﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), charging them with ignorance; «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يقسمون﴾ is the khabar (predicate); «رحمة ربك»: the object of ﴿يقسمون﴾.
﴿نحن قسمنا بينهم معيشتهم في الحياة الدنيا﴾: «نحن»: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿قسمنا﴾ is the khabar; «بينهم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قسمنا﴾; «معيشتهم»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «في الحياة الدنيا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ورفعنا بعضهم فوق بعض درجات ليتخذ بعضهم بعضا سخريا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «رفعنا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «بعضهم»: mafʿūl bihi; «فوق بعض»: an adverb attached to ﴿رفعنا﴾; «درجات»: tamyīz (specification); the lām is causal (lil-taʿlīl), and it has been said: of becoming (ṣayrūra) or outcome (ʿāqiba); «يتخذ»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿رفعنا﴾; «بعضهم»: fāʿil; «بعضًا»: first mafʿūl bihi; «سخريًّا»: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ورحمت ربك خير مما يجمعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «رحمة ربك»: mubtadaʾ; «خير»: khabar; «مما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجمعون﴾ [Translator's note: so in the text; «مما» is normally attached to «خير»]; the clause ﴿يجمعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿ولولا أن يكون الناس أمة واحدة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لولا»: a particle of impossibility because of existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; «الناس»: the noun of «يكون»; «أمة»: its khabar; «واحدة»: a naʿt (adjective) of «أمة».
﴿لجعلنا لمن يكفر بالرحمن لبيوتهم سقفا من فضة ومعارج عليها يظهرون﴾: the lām is connective for the apodosis; «جعلنا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «لمن»: in the place of the second object; the clause ﴿يكفر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. «بالرحمن»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكفر﴾; «لبيوتهم»: a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of ﴿لمن يكفر﴾, with repetition of the preposition; «سقفًا»: the first object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; «من فضة»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿سقفًا﴾; the clause ﴿ولولا أن يكون الناس...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «معارج»: conjoined to ﴿سقفًا﴾; «عليها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يظهرون﴾; «يظهرون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the clause is a ṣifa of ﴿معارج﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿ولبيوتهم أبوابا وسررا عليها يتكئون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لبيوتهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to ﴿لمن﴾ in the previous ayah and attached to (mutaʿalliq) what it is attached to; «أبوابا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), conjoined to ﴿سقفا﴾; «سررا»: also conjoined; «عليها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتكئون﴾; «يتكئون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the clause ﴿يتكئون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سررا﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وزخرفا وإن كل ذلك لما متاع الحياة الدنيا﴾: «زخرفًا»: conjoined to ﴿سررًا﴾, or the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «وجعلنا لهم زخرفًا» (and We would have made for them ornament of gold), or conjoined to the position of «من فضة»; the wāw is a conjunction; «إن»: negative; «كل ذلك»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «لما»: with shadda, in the sense of «إلا» (except); «متاع الحياة الدنيا»: khabar (predicate).
﴿والآخرة عند ربك للمتقين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «الآخرة»: mubtadaʾ; «عند ربك»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «للمتقين»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «الآخرة».

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿ومن يعش عن ذكر الرحمن نقيض له شيطانا فهو له قرين﴾: «من»: a conditional noun that makes jussive, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); «يعش»: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «عن ذكر الرحمن»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعش﴾; «نقيض»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of condition and requital are the khabar (predicate) of «مَن»; «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نقيض﴾; «شيطانًا»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿نقيض﴾; the fāʾ is a conjunction; «هو»: mubtadaʾ; «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a ṣifa (adjective) of «قرين» and was put before it; «قرين»: khabar.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وإنهم ليصدونهم عن السبيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ: the noun of «إن»; the mīm: the sign of the plural; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause ﴿يصدونهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «عن السبيل»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدونهم﴾.
﴿ويحسبون أنهم مهتدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or a conjunction; «يحسبون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; «أن» is an abrogating particle, ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and «مهتدون» is its khabar; the clause stands in place of the two objects of ﴿يحسبون﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿حتى إذا جاءنا قال يا ليت بيني وبينك بعد المشرقين﴾: «حتى»: a particle of limit and of the genitive; «إذا»: an adverb for future time, containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿جاءنا﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿جاءنا﴾ refers back to the one who turns away (al-ʿāshī), taken from the preceding ﴿يعش﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not make jussive; «يا»: a particle of alerting (tanbīh), or a vocative particle, the one addressed being omitted, its implied form evident; «ليت»: a particle of wishing (tamannī) and of the accusative; «بيني»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ليت﴾; «بينك»: conjoined to ﴿بيني﴾; «بعد المشرقين»: the postponed noun of «ليت».
﴿فبئس القرين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); «بئس»: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; «القرين»: the fāʿil of «بئس»; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "you" (أنت).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿ولن ينفعكم اليوم إذ ظلمتم أنكم في العذاب مشتركون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لن»: a particle of negation, of the accusative and of the future; «ينفعكم»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; «اليوم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينفعكم﴾; «إذ»: an adverb for past time, a badal (substitute) of ﴿اليوم﴾, the implied form being «إذ صحَّ وتبيَّن أنكم ظلمتم» (when it has been established and made clear that you did wrong); and it has been said: ﴿إذ﴾ here is causal, the implied form being «ولن ينفعكم اليوم اشتراككم في العذاب لأجل ظلمكم في الدنيا» (your sharing in the punishment will not benefit you today, because of your wrongdoing in the world); the clause ﴿ظلمتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿ينفعكم﴾, i.e. your sharing in the punishment will not benefit you as sharing in the misfortunes of this world benefits; and it has been said: the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «تمنيكم» (your wishing), and «أن» and what follows it are in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «لأنكم» (because you are), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿ينفعكم﴾; «في العذاب»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مشتركون﴾; «مشتركون»: the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; the clause ﴿ولن ينفعكم اليوم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿أفأنت تسمع الصم أو تهدي العمي﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation expressing wonder (istifhām inkārī taʿajjubī); the fāʾ is a conjunction, conjoining to an omitted implied [clause]; «أنت»: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿تسمع﴾ is the khabar (predicate); «الصم»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أو»: a conjunction; the clause ﴿تهدي العمي﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تسمع الصم﴾.
﴿ومن كان في ضلال مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «مَن»: a relative noun, conjoined to ﴿العمي﴾; the clause ﴿كان...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. The noun of «كان» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «في ضلال»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of «كان»; «مبين»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ضلال﴾.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿فإما نذهبن بك فإنا منهم منتقمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إن»: conditional, its nūn assimilated into «ما»; «ما»: redundant (ṣila); «نذهبن»: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «بك»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نذهبن﴾; «فإنا»: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «نا»: the noun of «إن»; «منهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿منتقمون﴾; «منتقمون»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause ﴿فإنا...﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿أو نرينك الذي وعدناهم فإنا عليهم مقتدرون﴾: «أو»: a conjunction; «نرينك»: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الذي»: the second object of ﴿نرينك﴾; the clause ﴿وعدناهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «نا»: the noun of «إن»; «عليهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مقتدرون﴾; «مقتدرون»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause ﴿فإنا...﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); «استمسك»: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «بالذي»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استمسك﴾; the clause ﴿أوحي إليك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إنك على صراط مستقيم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is a causal explanation of the command; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf: the noun of «إن»; «على صراط»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «مستقيم»: a naʿt (adjective) of «صراط».

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿وإنه لذكر لك ولقومك وسوف تسألون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is the noun of «إن»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «ذِكْر»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «لك»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذِكْر﴾, or a ṣifa (adjective) of it; «لقومك»: conjoined to ﴿لك﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; «سوف»: a particle of the future; «تسألون»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿واسأل من أرسلنا من قبلك من رسلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «اسأل»: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «مَن»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. «من قبلك»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; «من رسلنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿أجعلنا من دون الرحمن آلهة يعبدون﴾: the clause stands in place of the two objects of ﴿اسأل﴾, which is suspended from operation by the interrogation; the hamza is for interrogation; «جعلنا»: a verb and its fāʿil; «من دون الرحمن»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; «آلهة»: the first object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; the clause ﴿يُعبدون﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿آلهة﴾; «يعبدون»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا إلى فرعون وملئه﴾: the wāw is for the oath, and the thing sworn by is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted «أقسم» (I swear); the lām is [in] the answer of the omitted oath; «قد»: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «أرسلنا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «موسى»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بآياتنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the bāʾ is of accompaniment (mulābasa); «إلى فرعون»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; «ملئه»: conjoined to ﴿فرعون﴾.
﴿فقال إني رسول رب العالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إني»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the yāʾ is its noun; «رسول»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «رب»: muḍāf; «العالمين»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause of «إن» and what follows it is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿فلما جاءهم بآياتنا إذا هم منها يضحكون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, conjoining to an implied [clause], i.e. so they asked him for the signs proving his truthfulness; «لما»: adverbial, temporal (ḥīniyya), or connective; «جاءهم»: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بآياتنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾; «إذا»: of surprise (fujāʾiyya), or an adverb governed by the verb of surprise which is the answer of ﴿لما﴾, or a particle; «هم» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «منها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضحكون﴾; the clause ﴿يضحكون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وما نريهم من آية إلا هي أكبر من أختها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما»: negative; «نريهم»: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «مِن»: a redundant (ṣila) preposition; «آية»: the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نريهم﴾; «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «هي»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «أكبر»: khabar (predicate); «من أختها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أكبر﴾; the clause ﴿هي أكبر...﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿آية﴾.
﴿وأخذناهم بالعذاب لعلهم يرجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أخذناهم»: a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; «بالعذاب»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخذناهم﴾; «لعلهم»: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is the noun of «لعل», and the clause ﴿يرجعون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿لعل﴾; the clause ﴿لعلهم يرجعون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وقالوا يا أيها الساحر ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك إننا لمهتدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قالوا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «يا»: a vocative particle for the intermediate [in distance]; «أي»: the one addressed, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), and ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); «الساحر»: a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «ادع»: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; «لنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ادع﴾; «ربك»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادع﴾; «ما»: relative, and the clause ﴿عهد﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) genitive by the bāʾ; «عندك»: an adverb attached to ﴿عهد﴾; «إننا»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is the noun of «إن», «لمهتدون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause ﴿إننا لمهتدون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فلما كشفنا عنهم العذاب إذا هم ينكثون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, conjoining to an omitted implied [clause], i.e. «فدعا موسى فلما كشفنا» (so Mūsā prayed, and when We removed); «لما»: connective, or temporal (ḥīniyya); «كشفنا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «عنهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كشفنا﴾; «العذاب»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إذا»: of surprise (fujāʾiyya), or an adverb governed by the verb of surprise which is the answer of ﴿لما﴾, or a particle; «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿ينكثون﴾ is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ونادى فرعون في قومه قال يا قوم أليس لي ملك مصر وهذه الأنهار تجري من تحتي أفلا تبصرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction; «نادى فرعون»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «في قومه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نادى﴾; «قال»: a past verb, and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿قال...﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. «يا قوم»: the one addressed, annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the hamza is for interrogation seeking affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); «ليس»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ), inflexible (jāmid) past verb; «لي»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ليس﴾; «ملك مصر»: its postponed noun; «وهذه»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هذه﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿الأنهار﴾ is a badal (substitute), and the clause ﴿تجري﴾ is the khabar, the clause being accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿هذه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ملك مصر﴾; «من تحتي»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; the clause ﴿ونادى فرعون في قومه...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أفلا»: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction conjoining to an implied [clause], and «لا» is negative; «تبصرون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿أم أنا خير من هذا الذي هو مهين﴾: «أم»: a conjunction; it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), implied as ﴿بل﴾, i.e. rather, I am better; and it has been said: it is disconnected, implied as ﴿بل وهمزة الاستفهام الإنكاري﴾ («بل» and the hamza of disapproving interrogation). «أنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «خير»: khabar (predicate); «من هذا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خير﴾; «الذي»: a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; «هو»: mubtadaʾ; «مهين»: khabar; the clause ﴿هو مهين﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يكاد يبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined to the ṣila of the relative noun; or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is likewise resumptive with no grammatical position; and it has been said: it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «لا»: negative; «يكاد»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿يبين﴾ is the khabar of «يكاد».

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿فلولا ألقي عليه أسورة من ذهب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لولا»: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) in the sense of «هلا» (why not); «ألقي»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «عليه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألقي﴾; «أسورة»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «من ذهب»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أسورة﴾.
﴿أو جاء معه الملائكة مقترنين﴾: «أو»: a conjunction; «جاء»: a past verb; «معه»: an adverb attached to ﴿جاء﴾; «الملائكة»: fāʿil (agent); «مقترنين»: ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. following one another, bearing witness to his truthfulness.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿فاستخف قومه فأطاعوه إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «استخف»: a past verb; «قومه»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «فأطاعوه»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أطاعوه» is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «هم»: the noun of «إن»; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إنهم...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; «كانوا»: «كان» is an abrogating particle [Translator's note: so in the text; «كان» is an abrogating (incomplete) verb, not a particle], the wāw of the group is its noun, «قومًا» is its khabar, and «فاسقين» is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿فلما آسفونا انتقمنا منهم فأغرقناهم أجمعين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما»: temporal (ḥīniyya), adverbial, or connective; «آسفونا»: a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿انتقمنا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿لما﴾; «منهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انتقمنا﴾; «فأغرقناهم»: conjoined to ﴿انتقمنا﴾; «أجمعين»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿فجعلناهم سلفا ومثلا للآخرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «جعلناهم»: a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «سلفًا»: a second mafʿūl bihi; «مثلًا»: conjoined to ﴿سلفًا﴾; «للآخرين»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿مثلًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿ولما ضرب ابن مريم مثلا إذا قومك منه يصدون﴾: «لما»: adverbial, temporal (ḥīniyya), or connective; «ضُرب»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «ابن مريم»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «مثلًا»: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because «ضُرب» has been made to include the sense of «جعل» (to make); or a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. he was mentioned as an example; «إذا»: of surprise (fujāʾiyya), or an adverb governed by the verb of surprise which is the answer of ﴿لما﴾, or a particle; «قومك»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «منه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدون﴾; the clause ﴿يصِدون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿قومك﴾.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وقالوا أآلهتنا خير أم هو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قالوا»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hamza is for interrogation; «آلهتنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «خير»: khabar (predicate); «أم»: a conjunction, and it is connected (muttaṣila); «هو»: conjoined to ﴿آلهتنا﴾.
﴿ما ضربوه لك إلا جدلا بل هم قوم خصمون﴾: «ما»: negative; «ضربوه»: a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «لك»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضربوه﴾; «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «جدلًا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. only disputing; «بل»: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); «هم»: mubtadaʾ; «قوم»: khabar; «خصمون»: a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿قوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿إن هو إلا عبد أنعمنا عليه وجعلناه مثلا لبني إسرائيل﴾: «إن»: negative; «هو»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «عبد»: the khabar (predicate) of «هو»; the clause ﴿أنعمنا﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of «عبد»; «عليه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنعمنا﴾; «جعلناه»: conjoined to ﴿أنعمنا﴾; «مثلًا»: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعلناه﴾; «لبني إسرائيل»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ṣifa of ﴿مثلًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿ولو نشاء لجعلنا منكم ملائكة في الأرض يخلفون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لو»: conditional; «نشاء»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); the lām occurs in the answer of ﴿لولا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the text; the particle in this ayah is «لو»]; «جعلنا»: a verb and its fāʿil; «منكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if ﴿جعلنا﴾ means "We made [into]"; if it means "We created", the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جعلنا﴾; «في الأرض»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخلفون﴾; the clause ﴿يخلفون﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿ملائكة﴾. And it has been said: «من» is for substitution (badaliyya), i.e. We would have made angels in your stead.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإنه لعلم للساعة فلا تمترن بها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ: the noun of «إن»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «علم»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «للساعة»: a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿علم﴾, i.e. one of its signs by which it is known, so the sign is called «علم» (knowledge) because knowledge is attained through it; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); «لا»: prohibitive; «تمترن»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, is the fāʿil (agent), and the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; «بها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمترن﴾.
﴿واتبعون هذا صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «اتبعون»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ, omitted in writing, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «هذا»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «صراط»: khabar; «مستقيم»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صراط﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿ولا يصدنكم الشيطان إنه لكم عدو مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا»: prohibitive; «يصدنكم»: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; the kāf: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الشيطان»: fāʿil (agent); «إنه»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is the noun of «إن»; «لكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «عدو»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «مبين»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عدو﴾; the clause ﴿إنه لكم عدو مبين﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿ولما جاء عيسى بالبينات قال قد جئتكم بالحكمة ولأبين لكم بعض الذي تختلفون فيه﴾: «لما»: connective, or temporal (ḥīniyya); «جاء عيسى»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «بالبينات»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاء﴾; the clause ﴿قال...﴾ has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿قد جئتكم...﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); «ولأبين»: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of purpose (lām al-taʿlīl); «أبين»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after the lām of purpose; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive by the lām; «لأبين»: a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to ﴿بالحكمة﴾; and it has been said: attached to an implied [verb], i.e. «وجئتكم لأبين» (and I have come to you to make clear). «لكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أبين﴾; «بعض الذي»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أبين﴾; the clause ﴿تختلفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «فيه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تختلفون﴾.
﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the statement is conjoined to what precedes it as the completion of the speech of ʿĪsā; or it is resumptive, and the statement is resumptive with no grammatical position, serving to point out the path of obedience and its clear highway; «اتقوا الله»: an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; «أطيعون»: conjoined to ﴿فاتقوا﴾; and the yāʾ omitted in ﴿وأطيعون﴾ out of regard for the script of the Muṣḥaf is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿إن الله هو ربي وربكم فاعبدوه هذا صراط مستقيم﴾: «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «الله»: the noun of «إن»; «هو»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «ربي»: khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of «إن»; «ربكم»: conjoined to ﴿ربي﴾; the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); «اعبدوه»: a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «هذا»: mubtadaʾ; «صراط»: khabar; «مستقيم»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صراط﴾; the clause ﴿هذا صراط مستقيم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿فاختلف الأحزاب من بينهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «اختلف الأحزاب»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «من بينهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿الأحزاب﴾.
﴿فويل للذين ظلموا من عذاب يوم أليم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ويل»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and beginning with it [though indefinite] is permissible because it includes the sense of supplication; «للذين»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; «من عذاب يوم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second khabar, or a ḥāl, i.e. being from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection; «أليم»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿يوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿هل ينظرون إلا الساعة أن تأتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون﴾: «هل»: an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation, i.e. they do not await; «ينظرون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «الساعة»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أن تأتيهم»: the maṣdar formed from «أن» and «تأتيهم» is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of ﴿الساعة﴾; «بغتة»: ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is circumstantial (lil-ḥāl); «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وهم لا يشعرون﴾ is a second ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿الأخلاء يومئذ بعضهم لبعض عدو إلا المتقين﴾: «الأخلاء»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «يومئذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عدو﴾; «إذٍ»: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being «يوم إذ تأتيهم الساعة» (on the day when the Hour comes to them); «بعضهم»: a second mubtadaʾ; «لبعض»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿عدو﴾; «عدو»: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿بعضهم﴾, and the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿الأخلاء﴾; «إلا»: a particle of exception; «المتقين»: excepted (mustathnā) by ﴿إلا﴾, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿يا عباد لا خوف عليكم اليوم ولا أنتم تحزنون﴾: the clause is the maqūl (object of speech) of an omitted saying, i.e. and it will be said to them; «يا»: a vocative particle; «عباد»: the one addressed, annexed to the yāʾ of the speaker, which is omitted out of regard for the script of the Muṣḥaf; «لا»: negative; «خوف»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and beginning with it [though indefinite] is permissible because it is preceded by a negation; «عليكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); «اليوم»: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «ولا»: conjoined to what preceded; «أنتم»: mubtadaʾ; ﴿تحزنون﴾ is a verbal clause in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as khabar.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿الذين آمنوا بآياتنا وكانوا مسلمين﴾: «الذين»: a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿عبادي﴾, because it is an annexed (muḍāf) vocative; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. «بآياتنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنوا﴾; «كانوا»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun, and «مسلمين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the ṣila; or: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿ادخلوا الجنة أنتم وأزواجكم تحبرون﴾: «ادخلوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «الجنة»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); «أنتم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «أزواجكم»: conjoined to ﴿أنتم﴾; the clause ﴿تحبرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿يطاف عليهم بصحاف من ذهب وأكواب﴾: «يطاف»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «عليهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «بصحاف»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يطاف﴾; «من ذهب»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿صحاف﴾; «أكواب»: conjoined to ﴿صحاف﴾.
﴿وفيها ما تشتهيه الأنفس وتلذ الأعين وأنتم فيها خالدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «فيها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «ما»: a relative, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿تشتهيه الأنفس﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿تلذ الأعين﴾: conjoined to the ṣila, falling within its scope; «أنتم»: mubtadaʾ; «فيها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; «خالدون»: the khabar of ﴿أنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿وتلك الجنة التي أورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تلك»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «الجنة»: khabar (predicate); «التي»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الجنة﴾; the clause ﴿أورثتموها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «بما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أورثتموها﴾; «كنتم»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿لكم فيها فاكهة كثيرة منها تأكلون﴾: «لكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «فيها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «فاكهة»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «كثيرة»: a ṣifa (adjective); «منها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلون﴾; the clause ﴿تأكلون﴾ is a ṣifa of ﴿فاكهة﴾. Or: ﴿الجنة﴾ in the previous ayah is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the clause ﴿لكم فيها فاكهة﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿إن المجرمين في عذاب جهنم خالدون﴾: «إن المجرمين»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «المجرمين» is the noun of «إن»; «في عذاب»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted first khabar (predicate), or attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; «جهنم»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «خالدون»: a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿لا يفتر عنهم وهم فيه مبلسون﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لا»: negative; «يفتر»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), with a latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), its implied form being "it" (هو), i.e. the punishment; «عنهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفتر﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (lil-ḥāl); «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «فيه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مبلسون﴾; «مبلسون»: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; the clause ﴿وهم فيه مبلسون﴾ is a second ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿وما ظلمناهم ولكن كانوا هم الظالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما»: negative; «ظلمناهم»: a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لكن»: lightened [from «لكنّ»] and inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala); «كانوا»: «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the group is its noun; «هم»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or it is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw; «الظالمين»: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿ونادوا يا مالك ليقض علينا ربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «نادوا»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the past is used to express the imperfect to announce the reality of its occurrence, so it belongs to the type of ﴿أتى أمر الله﴾; «يا»: for the vocative; «مالك»: the one addressed, a singular proper name, with ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); the lām is the lām of request, its purpose being supplication; «يقض»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of request; «علينا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقض﴾, i.e. let Him cause us to die; «ربك»: fāʿil.
﴿قال إنكم ماكثون﴾: «قال»: a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf: the noun of «إن»; the mīm: the sign of the plural; «ماكثون»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause ﴿إنكم ماكثون﴾ is in the place of an accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿لقد جئناكم بالحق ولكن أكثركم للحق كارهون﴾: the lām is [in] the answer of the omitted oath; «قد»: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «جئناكم»: a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بالحق»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جئناكم﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لكن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «أكثركم»: the noun of «لكن», and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «للحق»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كارهون﴾; «كارهون»: the khabar (predicate) of «لكن».

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿أم أبرموا أمرا فإنا مبرمون﴾ «أم»: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), in the sense of «بل» (rather) and the hamza of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); «أبرموا»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «أمرًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «نا»: the noun of «إن»; «مبرمون»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿أم يحسبون أنا لا نسمع سرهم ونجواهم﴾: «أم»: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), in the sense of «بل» (rather) and the hamza of interrogation; «يحسبون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «أن» and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of «يحسبون»; the clause ﴿لا نسمع﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أنا﴾; «سرهم»: the object of ﴿نسمع﴾; «نجواهم»: conjoined to ﴿سرهم﴾.
﴿بلى ورسلنا لديهم يكتبون﴾: «بلى»: a particle of answer, for cancelling the negation, i.e. yes indeed, We hear their secret and their private counsel. The wāw is circumstantial (lil-ḥāl); «رسلنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «لديهم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكتبون﴾; the clause ﴿يكتبون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿رسلنا﴾; the clause ﴿ورسلنا...﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿قل إن كان للرحمن ولد فأنا أول العابدين﴾: «قل»: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «إن»: conditional; «كان»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; «للرحمن»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «ولد»: the postponed noun of «كان»; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «أنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «أول العابدين»: khabar.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿سبحان رب السماوات والأرض رب العرش عما يصفون﴾: «سبحان»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb; «رب السماوات والأرض»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «رب العرش»: a badal (substitute) of the first ﴿رب﴾; «عما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبحان﴾; the clause ﴿يصفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); «ذرهم»: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يخوضوا»: the answer of the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and for that reason it is jussive (majzūm); «يلعبوا»: conjoined to ﴿يخوضوا﴾; «حتى»: a particle of limit and of the genitive; «يلاقوا»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after ﴿حتى﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذرهم﴾; «يومهم»: mafʿūl bihi; «الذي»: a ṣifa (adjective); the clause ﴿يوعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «يوعدون»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿وهو الذي في السماء إله وفي الأرض إله وهو الحكيم العليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «هو»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «الذي»: its khabar (predicate); «في السماء»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿إله﴾, because it means "worshipped"; «إله»: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هو» (He), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position. «في الأرض إله»: conjoined to His words ﴿في السماء إله﴾; «هو»: mubtadaʾ; «الحكيم العليم»: two khabars.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿وتبارك الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض وما بينهما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تبارك»: a past verb; «الذي»: its fāʿil (agent); «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «ملك»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). «السماوات»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿له ملك السماوات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. «ما»: conjoined to ﴿السماوات والأرض﴾, and the adverb is attached to an omitted [verb] which is the ṣila.
﴿وعنده علم الساعة وإليه ترجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «عنده»: an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «علم الساعة»: a postponed mubtadaʾ; «إليه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾; «ترجعون»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿ولا يملك الذين يدعون من دونه الشفاعة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا»: negative; «يملك»: an imperfect verb; «الذين»: fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «من دونه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدعون﴾; «الشفاعة»: the object of ﴿يملك﴾.
﴿إلا من شهد بالحق وهم يعلمون﴾: «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «مَن»: excepted (mustathnā) from ﴿الذين﴾, and the exception is connected (muttaṣil) because the angels, the Messiah and ʿUzayr are included among what they worship; the meaning is: except those who bore witness to the truth, such as ʿUzayr, the Messiah and the angels, for they do possess intercession, by Allah's granting it to them. The clause ﴿شهد بالحق﴾ is the ṣila of «مَن»; ﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction; «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿ولئن سألتهم من خلقهم ليقولن الله فأنى يؤفكون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām prepares for the oath (mūṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); «إن»: conditional; «سألتهم»: a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «مَن»: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿خلقهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «مَن»; the suspended interrogative clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿سألتهم﴾; «ليقولن»: the lām is [in] the answer of the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted; «يقولن»: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, is the fāʿil; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; «الله»: the fāʿil of an omitted verb indicated by the interrogative relative [i.e. the question], the implied form being «خلقنا الله» (Allah created us); and it has been said: a mubtadaʾ; the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أنى»: an interrogative noun in the sense of «كيف» (how), in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); «يؤفكون»: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t: ﴿وقيله يا رب﴾: the wāw is for the oath; «قيله», i.e. ﴿قوله﴾ (his saying), is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being «أقسم» (I swear); the answer [of the oath] is either omitted, i.e. «لأفعلن بهم ما أريد» (I shall surely do with them what I will), or stated, namely His words ﴿إن هؤلاء قوم لا يؤمنون﴾: as though it were said: «وأُقسم بقيله يا رب» (and I swear by his saying "O my Lord"); «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «هؤلاء»: the noun of «إن»; «قوم»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿فاصفح عنهم وقل سلام فسوف يعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); «اصفح»: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «عنهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اصفح﴾; «قل»: conjoined to ﴿فاصفح﴾; «سلام»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «الأمر سلام» (the matter is peace); «فسوف»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «سوف» is a particle of the future; «يعلمون»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted for magnification, i.e. the outcome of their affair.

nahhas-irab:1-3.t: (الْكِتابِ) is genitive (makhfūḍ) by the wāw of oath, which is a substitute for the bāʾ because of its closeness to it and its resemblance to it. (الْمُبِينِ) is a naʿt (adjective). The response to the oath is (إِنَّا جَعَلْناهُ): the hāʾ in جعلناه is the first object and «قرآنا» the second object. This is the جعلنا that takes two objects, meaning "We made [it] become", and not the جعلنا meaning "We created", because that one takes only one object, as in His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: وَجَعَلَ الظُّلُماتِ وَالنُّورَ [al-Anʿām: 1]; the Arabs distinguished between the two by what we have mentioned. (لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ): that is, so that you may understand the command of Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, and His prohibition, since He sent down the Quran in your tongue.

nahhas-irab:4-4.t: (وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتابِ): that is, the Quran is in the Preserved Tablet. (لَعَلِيٌّ): that is, high and exalted. It was also said: علي means overpowering and inimitable, the like of which cannot be produced. (حَكِيمٌ): made firm (muḥkam) in its rulings and its composition.

nahhas-irab:5-5.t:
(أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحاً): al-Farrāʾ said: one says أضربت عنك and ضربت عنك, meaning "I turned away from you and left you". On the accusative of صفحا there are several views. Among them: that the meaning of (أَفَنَضْرِبُ) is "shall We turn aside (أفنصفح)", as one says هو يدعه تركا ("he leaves it a leaving"), because the meaning of يدعه is يتركه. It may be that صفحا means صافحين ("turning aside", a ḥāl), as you say جاء زيد مشيا, that is, ماشيا ("walking"). And it may be that صفحا means ذوي صفح ("possessors of turning aside"), as one says رجل عدل, that is, عادل ("just"), and likewise رضى. This is a good answer.
The scholars differed about the meaning of (الذِّكْرَ) here. Juwaybir narrated from al-Ḍaḥḥāk: (أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ) — he said: the Quran. Abū Ṣāliḥ said about (أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ): "Shall We withhold the Reminder from you and leave you neglected as you were?" Abū Jaʿfar said: These views, even if different in wording, are close in meaning. Whoever said "the Reminder is the punishment" construed it as meaning "the mention of punishment", and the mention of punishment, when it is sent down, is Quran. Whoever said its meaning is "Shall We withhold the Reminder from you and leave you neglected" construed it as: "Shall We refrain from sending down to you the Reminder in which is command and prohibition, and so leave you unattended?" Abū Jaʿfar said: This is a good, sound, clear view, that is: "Shall We leave you unattended, neither commanding you nor forbidding you nor punishing you for your disbelief, after the proofs have become manifest to you, because you were an extravagant people?" This is according to the reading of whoever puts a fatḥa on «أن», which is the reading of al-Ḥasan, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn Kathīr and ʿĀṣim [Translator's note: so in the source]; the rest of the readers have a kasra on «إن», that is: "whenever you are extravagant, We do this to you".

nahhas-irab:6-7.t:
(كَمْ) is in the position of the accusative; it is the counterpart of ربّ in the declarative [use]. Some Arabs drop «من» and use the accusative, and some use the genitive even when they drop «من», as [the poet] said [metre: al-sarīʿ], verse 408:
كم بجود مقرف نال العلى ... وكريم بخله قد وضعه
(How many a base-born man has attained eminence through generosity, and how many a noble man has his stinginess brought low!)
The most eloquent usage, when there is separation, is to bring «من»; this is the usage the Quran came with, as with everything the Quran came with. Sometimes error occurs from some lexicographers in what they mention as eloquent speech, but the meticulous scholars do not do that. Among what some of them mentioned as eloquent speech: someone claimed that one says أضربت عن الشّيء with the alif, and claimed it is the eloquent usage. I heard ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān [al-Akhfash al-Aṣghar] say: This is an error; the eloquent [form] is ضربت عن الشيء, because of the consensus of the authorities in the reading of al-Farrāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; «القرّاء» (the readers) is apparently meant] (أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحاً) with a fatḥa on the nūn. And some of them mentioned that the eloquent [form] is عظّم الله أجرك, whereas the consensus of the authorities in the reading of the readers is وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْراً [al-Ṭalāq: 2 — Translator's note: the verse is al-Ṭalāq: 5], and in many [other] words.

nahhas-irab:8-8.t: (فَأَهْلَكْنا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشاً وَمَضى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ) (8): (فَأَهْلَكْنا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشاً): [بطشا] is accusative as clarification (bayān, i.e. tamyīz — specification). (وَمَضى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ): Qatāda said: that is, punishment. «مثل» here may mean "description", that is, their description as having been destroyed when they denied; and مثل may be in its usual sense.

nahhas-irab:10-10.t: (الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْداً): «الذي» is in the position of the nominative, as a naʿt (adjective) of العزيز, or with an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), because it is the beginning of a verse.

nahhas-irab:11-11.t: The kāf is in the position of the accusative, that is: you will be brought forth with a bringing forth like that. ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd explained the meaning of this — and it is something that is accepted only by revealed instruction (tawqīf) — he said: Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, will send down water like the semen of men, and there is nothing created from the earth but something of it has remained, so the bodies will grow by that, and flesh will grow from moist soil and rain. Then ʿAbd Allāh recited: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنْشَرْنا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتاً كَذلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ.

nahhas-irab:12-12.t: (وَالَّذِي) is in the position of the nominative by conjunction. (خَلَقَ الْأَزْواجَ): the plural of زوج, made plural on the pattern أفعال. The way of فَعْل from other than this kind is to be made plural on أفْعُل, but they disliked saying أزوُج because the vowel on the wāw is heavy, so it was shifted to the plural of فَعَل, since the number of letters is the same; they likened فَعْلًا to فَعَل just as they likened فَعَلًا to فَعْل, saying زمن and أزمن. (كُلَّها) is tawkīd (emphasis), and some grammarians call it a ṣifa (qualifier). The usage of كلّها is for a large plural, while for a small plural [one says] كلّهن. (وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعامِ ما تَرْكَبُونَ): if you make «ما» mean «الذي» (that which), the pronoun is omitted because of the length of the relative [Translator's note: the source has «الموسم», apparently a corruption of «الموصول», the relative]; were the pronoun overt, «مما تركبونه» would be permissible, according to the wording of «ما», and «مما تركبونها», according to the feminine of the group. If you make «ما» a maṣdar [particle], no omission is needed.

nahhas-irab:13-13.t: (لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلى ظُهُورِهِ): al-Farrāʾ said: He did not say ظهورها because it is in the sense of «كثر الدرهم» ("the dirham became plentiful"), that is, it is in the sense of the genus. Abū Jaʿfar said: More fitting than this is that it refers back to the wording of «ما», because its wording is masculine and singular; and likewise (ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنا هذا وَما كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ) came in the masculine.

nahhas-irab:14-14.t: Conjoined to the speech before it.

nahhas-irab:15-15.t:
(وَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْ عِبادِهِ جُزْءاً): its meaning has been mentioned in three views. Ibn Abī Najīḥ narrated from Mujāhid: «جزءا» — he said: a child and daughters. ʿAṭāʾ said: he means a share, a partnership. Zayd ibn Aslam said: it is the idols. These are two views. Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] mentioned a third view, namely that جزءا is specifically for daughters, and recited a verse to that effect which he claimed [was attested] [metre: al-basīṭ], verse 409:
إن أجزأت حرّة يوما فلا عجب ... قد تجزئ الحرّة المذكار أحيانا
(If a free woman one day bears a girl, it is no wonder; the free woman who usually bears males sometimes bears girls.)
That is, she gives birth to females. Abū Jaʿfar said: What the consensus of authorities among the exegetes and lexicographers holds is that الجزء is "the share"; this is the position of ʿAṭāʾ, which we mentioned, and of Mujāhid, al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas and al-Ḍaḥḥāk, and it is the meaning of the view of Ibn ʿAbbās. Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad] said: الجزء is the share. As for the view of Zayd ibn Aslam, the consensus of the authorities is also against it, and the transmitted report indicates otherwise, as does the sequence of the speech, because after it comes وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبادُ الرَّحْمنِ إِناثاً. And it was said: this too follows on from that.

nahhas-irab:16-16.t: (أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَناتٍ): this indicates that this does not concern the idols.

nahhas-irab:17-17.t: (ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا): the noun (ism) of ظلّ and its khabar (predicate). In ordinary speech «ظلّ وجهه مسودّ» is permissible, with a nominative pronoun in ظلّ referring back to «أحد»; then وجهه is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) and مسودّ is its khabar, and the mubtadaʾ with its khabar is the khabar of the first. Similar to it is what Sībawayh reported: «كلّ مولود يولد على الفطرة حتّى يكون أبواه هما اللذان يهوّدانه أو ينصّرانه» ("Every child is born upon the natural disposition until it is his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian"); Sībawayh reported both the nominative and the accusative in «اللّذين».

nahhas-irab:18-18.t:
(أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ): Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] said: «من» is in the position of the accusative, the meaning being "or have you made [His share] one who is brought up…". Al-Farrāʾ said: «من» is in the position of the nominative as a new start (istiʾnāf), and he permitted the accusative; he said: if you refer it back to the beginning of the speech, to His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: وَإِذا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِما ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمنِ مَثَلًا.
The readers differed over the reading of this word. Ibn ʿAbbās and the Kufans other than ʿĀṣim read (أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ), and the people of the two Sanctuaries, Abū ʿAmr and ʿĀṣim read (أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا) [Translator's note: the two readings are printed identically in the source; from the argument that follows, one of them is «يَنْشَأُ» (grows up) and the other «يُنَشَّأُ» (is brought up)]. Abū ʿUbayd argued for the first reading with His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: إِنَّا أَنْشَأْناهُنَّ إِنْشاءً [al-Wāqiʿa: 35]. Abū Jaʿfar said: They are two well-known readings that the community has transmitted, and there is no proof in what he adduced, because we know that one is not brought up until… [Translator's note: the text appears defective here]. And if what he said were binding, one would not say «مات فلان» ("So-and-so died") because of His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ [al-Baqara: 28, al-Ḥajj: 66, al-Rūm: 40]; it would be required to say «أميت» ("he was caused to die"), and likewise «حيي». The difference, according to the grammarians, is contrary to what he said, namely that the meaning of ينشّأ is time after time, by way of intensification (taktīr).

nahhas-irab:19-21.t:
(وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبادُ الرَّحْمنِ إِناثاً): two objects; that is, they described them as being thus and judged them to be so. The reading of this too was disputed: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbbās, the Kufans and Abū ʿAmr read (عِبادُ الرَّحْمنِ), while the people of the two Sanctuaries, al-Ḥasan and Abū Rajāʾ read «عند الرحمن». Abū ʿUbayd argued for the reading of those who read (عِبادُ الرَّحْمنِ) on the grounds that its chain of transmission is higher and that it is a rebuttal of their saying "the angels are the daughters of Allah": so He said, they are not daughters; they are servants.
Abū Jaʿfar said: They are two well-known, recognised readings, except that the more fitting of them is «عند», from more than one angle, and what Abū ʿUbayd argued is not binding, because he argued that the chain of transmission in the reading «عباد» is higher. By my life, it is authentic from Ibn ʿAbbās; but if you reflect on what is in the ḥadīth, you will see that the ḥadīth itself requires that it be read «عند», because Saʿīd ibn Jubayr argued against Ibn ʿAbbās with the codex, saying: "In my codex it is «عند»." This is a decisive proof, because the consensus of the authorities among the written codices, as transmitted by the community, is that it is «عند». Had it been «عباد», it would have had to be written with the alif, as بَلْ عِبادٌ مُكْرَمُونَ [al-Anbiyāʾ: 26] was written. And his argument that it is a rebuttal of their saying "daughters" is not binding, because «عباد» is only a denial against whoever said "a child", since it applies to masculine and feminine. More consistent with the sequence of the verse is the reading of whoever read «عند», because the meaning in it is: "and they made the angels, who are with the All-Merciful, [females]", that is, they did not see them as females, so how could they say this when they are with the All-Merciful and not with them?
(أَشَهِدُوا خَلْقَهُمْ): the reading of Nāfiʿ; as for the rest of the readers, as far as we know, they read «أشهدوا» [Translator's note: the two forms are printed alike in the source; Nāfiʿ's reading is «أَأُشْهِدُوا» (were they made witnesses) and the others' «أَشَهِدُوا» (did they witness), as the following argument shows]. They are two good readings that the community has transmitted, and the meaning in them is close, because if they witnessed, then they were made witnesses. His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلائِكَةَ إِناثاً وَهُمْ شاهِدُونَ [al-Ṣāffāt: 150] supports the reading of whoever read «أشهدوا», and the other is permissible and good; He, Majestic and Mighty is He, said: ما أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ [al-Kahf: 51].

nahhas-irab:22-26.t:
(بَلْ قالُوا إِنَّا وَجَدْنا آباءَنا عَلى أُمَّةٍ): this is the reading on which the consensus of the authorities rests, and the known usage. «الأمّة» is religion; from it is كانَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً واحِدَةً [al-Baqara: 213], that is, upon one religion. The reading of Mujāhid and ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, may Allah have mercy on him, is (عَلى أُمَّةٍ) [i.e. «إِمَّة»] with a kasra on the hamza.
(وَإِنَّا عَلى آثارِهِمْ مُهْتَدُونَ): the original is إنّنا; the nūn was dropped for lightness. (مُهْتَدُونَ) is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ»; the accusative is permissible outside the Quran as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and likewise (مُقْتَدُونَ). Maʿmar narrated from Qatāda on (إِلَّا قالَ مُتْرَفُوها): he said: their heads and nobles. Yazīd ibn al-Qaʿqāʿ read «قل اولو جئناكم» [Translator's note: so in the source; from what follows, his reading is «قُلْ أَوَلَوْ جِئْنَاكُمْ» (Say: even if We brought you), with the plural «جئناكم», against «جئتكم» of the others]. Abū ʿUbayd considered this reading far-fetched, arguing that before it is «قل» and He did not say «قلنا». The argument for this reading is that before it is (إِنَّا بِما أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كافِرُونَ), so the Prophet ﷺ addressed them with «جئنا» on his own behalf and on behalf of the messengers, peace be upon them, and said: «أو لو جئناكم».
(بَراءٌ) is the reading on which rests the authority of the community and the main body [of codices]. From Ibn Masʿūd [it is reported] that he read إِنَّنِي بَرِيءٌ; except that al-Farrāʾ said that the like of this is written with the alif, and he permitted every hamza to be written as an alif. Abū Jaʿfar said: This is anomalous and far-fetched; whoever says it would be obliged to write يستهزئ with the alif, and this contains a difficulty and a contradiction of the community that is grosser and uglier. Whoever reads برآء says برآء in the dual and the plural as well, the implied meaning being "I am a possessor of disavowal", like لكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ [al-Baqara: 177]. Whoever says بريء says in its plural برءاء or برآء, on the pattern of كرماء and كرام. The Kufans reported a third plural that they alone report: they reported برآء on the pattern of براع, and claimed that it is shortened from برءاء.

nahhas-irab:27-27.t: (إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي) is in the position of the accusative as an exception from the saying «ما تعبدون»; it may also be a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ).

nahhas-irab:28-28.t: (وَجَعَلَها): the hāʾ and alif are an allusion to his saying «إنّني برآء» and what follows it, that is: and He made his disavowal of everything they worship besides Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, and his devotion of pure tawḥīd to Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, (كَلِمَةً باقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ). The latent agent in «جعلها» may refer back to His saying (الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي), that is: and Allah the Exalted made it a word lasting among his descendants. The exegetes hold, on this [view], that there will never cease to be monotheists among the offspring of Ibrāhīm ﷺ. It was also said: the pronoun refers back to Ibrāhīm, that is: he made it a lasting word among his descendants, that is, he taught them tawḥīd and disavowal of everything worshipped besides Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, so they inherited it and it became a lasting word among his descendants. One also says «في عقْبه», dropping the kasra because it is heavy.

nahhas-irab:31-31.t: (وَقالُوا لَوْلا نُزِّلَ هذَا الْقُرْآنُ عَلى رَجُلٍ): [القرآن is] by way of ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), which stands in the place of the naʿt (adjective) for هذا; this is Sībawayh's view, while others say: a naʿt. (عَلى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ): [عظيم] is a naʿt of رجل. The man is not from both towns; rather its literal sense in Arabic is "upon a man from [one of] the men of the two towns", then [the muḍāf] was omitted, like وَسْئَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ [Yūsuf: 82]. As for His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هؤُلاءِ وَآباءَهُمْ حَتَّى جاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ, its meaning is: I did not destroy them as I destroyed other disbelievers.

nahhas-irab:32-32.t: (أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ): «هم» is nominative with an implied verb, because the question is about the verb; and its position may be nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). (نَحْنُ قَسَمْنا بَيْنَهُمْ مَعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا وَرَفَعْنا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجاتٍ): that is, likewise We have preferred some of them over others by selection and choice. (دَرَجاتٍ) is in the position of the accusative as a second object from which «إلى» has been dropped. (لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضاً سُخْرِيًّا): that is, We have preferred some of them over others in provision so that some of them may be put to service for others. Everyone who does work for a man has been put to his service, whether for a wage or without a wage. From Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Ḍaḥḥāk on (لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضاً سُخْرِيًّا): he said: slaves. Al-Farrāʾ said: one says سُخريّ and سِخريّ with one meaning, here and in [Sūrat] قَدْ أَفْلَحَ [al-Muʾminūn: 1] and in «Ṣād» [Translator's note: the two forms are printed alike in the source; the distinction is between ḍamma and kasra on the sīn]. Abū Jaʿfar said: The matter is as al-Farrāʾ said, according to all the lexicographers, except for something that Abū ʿAmr mentioned.

nahhas-irab:33-34.t:
(وَلَوْلا أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً واحِدَةً): al-Farrāʾ said: «أن» is in the position of the nominative. (لَجَعَلْنا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفاً مِنْ فِضَّةٍ): about «بيوتهم» there is more than one view. Among them: the meaning is "upon their houses". It was also said: it is a badal (substitute) with repetition of the particle, like قالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِمَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُمْ [al-Aʿrāf: 75]. Abū Jaʿfar said: This view is nearer to correctness, because particles are not moved from their usual sense except by a proof to which one must submit.
«سُقُفاً» in the plural is the reading of al-Ḥasan, Mujāhid, Abū Rajāʾ, al-Aʿraj, Shayba, Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī; while the reading of Abū ʿAmr, Abū Jaʿfar, Ibn Kathīr, Shibl and Ḥumayd is «سَقْفاً» in the singular [Translator's note: the vowelling of the two forms is not distinguished in the source]. Abū Jaʿfar said: سُقُف, according to what Abū ʿUbayd mentioned, is the plural of سَقْف, like رَهْن and رُهُن. I saw ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān reject this, because it is not a regular plural of فَعْل. He said: رُهُن is the plural of رِهان, like حمار and حُمُر, and رِهان is the plural of رَهْن, like عبد and عباد; and likewise «سقفا». Al-Farrāʾ reported that سُقُف is the plural of سقيفة.
As for the reading of whoever read (لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفاً مِنْ فِضَّةٍ) [Translator's note: the singular «سَقْفاً» is meant here], Ismāʿīl ibn Isḥāq interpreted it as «من» being for one [person]; he said: the meaning is "We would have made for every one who disbelieves in the All-Merciful, for their houses, a roof of silver". But he considered this reading far-fetched, and it was reported [from him] that this is a far-fetched interpretation; he argued that the plural reading is more fitting because after it come «ومعارج», «وسررا» and «وأبوابا», so likewise «سقف» in the plural is more fitting. Abū Jaʿfar said: What he interpreted is far-fetched; more fitting than it is that سَقْف should be in the sense of سُقُف, as He, Majestic and Mighty is He, said: ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا [al-Ḥajj: 5], and as the poet said [metre: al-wāfir], verse 410:
كلوا في بعض بطنكم تعفّوا ... فإنّ زمانكم زمن خميص
(Eat with part of your belly, and you will remain abstinent, for your time is a time of hunger.)
The ḥadīths indicate that the reading is «سقف» [in the plural], as does the sequence of the speech, as Bakr ibn Sahl narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Muʿāwiya ibn Ṣāliḥ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa, from Ibn ʿAbbās, on His saying, Majestic and Mighty is He: وَلَوْلا أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً واحِدَةً, the verse and the one after it; he said: He, Glorified is He, says: "Were it not that all people would be made disbelievers, I would have made for the disbelievers, for their houses, roofs of silver, and stairways upon them of silver, and «زخرفا»" — he said: gold. Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and al-Shaʿbī said: (لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفاً), that is, beams. All of this indicates the plural.

nahhas-irab:35-35.t: (وَزُخْرُفاً) is conjoined to «سقف». Al-Farrāʾ claimed that its meaning may be "roofs of silver and of gold (زخرف)", then «من» was dropped and so it was put in the accusative. The first view is nearer to correctness. Ibn Zayd claimed that الزخرف is household furnishings; but most exegetes, among them Ibn ʿAbbās, al-Ḥasan, Mujāhid and Qatāda, said: الزخرف is gold. Al-Shaʿbī said: الزخرف is gold and silver. Abū Jaʿfar said: الزخرف in the language, according to what Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad] reported, is adornment; he said: one says بنى داره فزخرفها, that is, he adorned it and beautified it. (وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذلِكَ لَمَّا مَتاعُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا): the lām is for emphasis according to the Basrans, and according to the Kufans [لمّا] is in the sense of «إلّا», and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis; according to some grammarians it is indefinite, meaning "a thing". (وَالْآخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ): nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); the implied meaning is "the reward of the Hereafter with your Lord is for the God-fearing".

nahhas-irab:36-36.t: (وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمنِ): Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad] said: يعش means "he feigns blindness"; its origin is from الأعشى, one whose sight has been overcome by weakness and darkness. From it comes «جاء فلان يعشو» when he comes to him by night, because of the darkness that overcomes his sight. Others said: «عشي عن ذكر الرحمن» means he did not benefit from the Reminder, just as الأعشى, who does not see in the light, does not benefit from his sight as others benefit. (يَعْشُ) is in the position of the jussive (jazm) by the condition, and the sign of the jussive in it is the dropping of the wāw. It is derived from العشي, except that one says عشي يعشى when he becomes أعشى (night-blind), and عشا يعشو when there befalls him what befalls the أعشى. It is from the [roots] with wāw; the yāʾ in عشي is changed from a wāw, and likewise the alif in عشا, which is the maṣdar (verbal noun). For this reason the grammarians said: العشا (night-blindness) in the eye is written with the alif; the proof of that is that one says امرأة عشواء. (نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

nahhas-irab:37-37.t: (وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ) is construed according to the meaning, because «شيطانا» conveys the meaning of «شياطين».

nahhas-irab:38-38.t: (حَتَّى إِذا جاءَنا) [i.e. «جاءانا», dual] is the reading of Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim and ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir, and it is the clear one, because the pronoun refers back to «من» and «القرين»; while the reading of Abū ʿAmr and the Kufans other than ʿĀṣim is (حَتَّى إِذا جاءَنا) [Translator's note: the two readings are printed alike in the source; the first is the dual «جاءانا» and the second the singular «جاءنا»], which has that same meaning, that is: until when he and his companion come to Us; and the Arabs omit the like of this, as one says كحلت عيني ("I applied kohl to my eye"), meaning both eyes. (قالَ يا لَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ): [بعد is] the noun (ism) of «ليت», and it [بيني وبينك] is an adverb (ẓarf), as one says: يا ليت بيني وبينك بعدا. And «بعدُ» [in the nominative] is permissible, meaning "would that [between me and you] were the extent of that". If you say ليت بيني وبينك متباعد, you use the nominative.

nahhas-irab:39-40.t: «أنّ» is in the position of the nominative, that is: your sharing will not benefit you; because when a person in this world is struck by a calamity along with others, it becomes somewhat easier for him and he takes consolation in them, but Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, has denied that to the people of the Fire.

nahhas-irab:41-43.t: (فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ) is in the position of the jussive (jazm) by the condition; the nūn is for emphasis, and were it not for it the bāʾ would be quiescent. Likewise (أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ) is in the position of the jussive; were it not for the nūn the yāʾ would be dropped, but it has been made indeclinable (mabnī) with it on the fatḥa.

nahhas-irab:44-44.t: (وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ): ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said: "The Quran is an honour for you and for your people." Mujāhid interpreted this as being an honour for Quraysh; he said: it is asked, "From whom is the man?" and it is said, "From the Arabs"; then it is asked, "From which of the Arabs?" and he says, "From Quraysh." Others said: his people here are those who believed in him and were upon his way. It was also said: the meaning of (وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ) is: "that which was revealed to you and to those before you is a reminder", that is, it was sent down so that you may be reminded by it and know the matter of your religion.

nahhas-irab:45-48.t:
Abū Jaʿfar said: There is a difficulty in this verse, because the Prophet ﷺ does not need to ask. We have mentioned the view of a group of scholars on it. Among them is one who said: there is an omission in the speech, the implied form being: "and ask those to whom We sent before you messengers from among Our messengers"; he said: the address is to the Prophet ﷺ, and those meant by it are the idolaters. Abū Jaʿfar said: As for the omission of «رسل» here, it is permissible, because «من رسلنا» indicates it, as the poet said [metre: al-wāfir], verse 411:
كأنّك من جمال بني أقيش
(As though you were of the camels of Banū Uqaysh)
the implied form being "as though you were a camel of the camels of Banū Uqaysh". But the omission of «إليه» is not permissible: if you said مررت بالذي ضربت or بالذي قام while intending the omission of the genitive particle and the pronoun, it would not be permissible; only the omission of the pronoun that is in the ṣila (relative clause) is permissible. And his saying "the one addressed is the Prophet ﷺ and those meant are the idolaters" is a statement open to question.
The [correct] view about the verse — and Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, knows best — is what Qatāda said; he said: "Ask the People of the Book: did Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, command anything but tawḥīd and sincere devotion?" The explanation of this in terms of Arabic is: Say, O Muḥammad, to whoever worships idols: Ask the nations of those We sent from among Our messengers — that is, those of them who believed — whether Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, commanded that an idol be worshipped, or that anything else be worshipped along with Him; for they will not find this in any of the Books. Then «أمم» (nations) was omitted and «من» was put in its place, like وَسْئَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ [Yūsuf: 82].

nahhas-irab:49-50.t: (وَقالُوا يا أَيُّهَا السَّاحِرُ), and Ibn ʿĀmir read (يا أَيُّهَا السَّاحِرُ) [Translator's note: so in the source, identical to the preceding; Ibn ʿĀmir's reading is «يا أَيُّهُ» with ḍamma on the hāʾ]. (ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ): «الساحر» is a naʿt (adjective) of أيّ according to the wording; the accusative is not permissible except in the view of al-Māzinī, according to the position, because the position of أيّ is accusative. Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] said: If someone says, "How did they say يا أيّها الساحر when they claimed that they would be guided?", [the answer is that] the address was made because he was called by this among them, so they said يا أيّها الساحر on that basis. Abū Jaʿfar said: We have mentioned an answer other than this.

nahhas-irab:51-51.t: (وَنادى فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ): it was said: his proclamation was out of dislike that his people should follow Mūsā ﷺ, because when [Mūsā] prayed, the punishment was lifted from them, and Pharaoh's inability to lift it became clear; so he disliked that they should follow him and said: "I am more deserving of being followed than he." (قالَ يا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ): [مصر] is in the position of the genitive, and it is a diptote according to the Basrans because it is a feminine named with a masculine [name]; likewise if a woman were named Zayd, it would be a diptote. They permitted مصر to be fully declined if it is taken as a name for the country (al-balad), but treating it as a diptote is better, because what is used for the like of it is بلدة (town, feminine). As for the Kufans, they hold that مصر is like a woman named Hind, so it ought to be fully declined, except that it was prevented from that because of its rarity in speech. (وَهذِهِ الْأَنْهارُ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِي): «تجري» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it may also be in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of هذه. (أَفَلا تُبْصِرُونَ).

nahhas-irab:52-52.t: (أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ هذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ): al-Farrāʾ said: it is of the questioning that comes with أم because of its connection with speech before it; he said: you may also refer it back to his saying «أليس لي ملك مصر». We have explained it more fully than this. Al-Farrāʾ claimed that one of the shaykhs told him that it is read «افلا تبصرون أما أنا خير». Abū Jaʿfar said: he construes it as the «أما» meaning «ألا» and "truly"; on this [reading] (أَفَلا تُبْصِرُونَ) is the end of the speech. This reading lies outside the proof of consensus, and on this [reading] «أما» would have to be [written] with the alif. «أنا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (خَيْرٌ) its khabar (predicate), and likewise (هُوَ مَهِينٌ). On the meaning of «مهين» there are two views. It was said: its meaning is one who demeans himself in his needs and his livelihood, having no one to provide for him. Al-Kisāʾī said: المهين is the weak and abased; one says مهن مهانة. This is nearer to correctness.
